scoreJustification: This unit achieves 91% due to exceptional community focus, outstanding developmental appropriateness, and authentic civic engagement opportunities. The progression from school community to neighborhood belonging is pedagogically sound and perfectly matched to Grade 1 capabilities. Community helper exploration provides concrete foundation for abstract civic concepts. Autumn integration feels natural and enhances rather than constrains learning. Minor deductions for field trip coordination complexity and need for more robust virtual alternatives. The unit successfully builds community appreciation, civic responsibility, and French vocabulary within an engaging, hands-on learning framework that honors both student development and curriculum expectations.
